component.name: Vingilot
component.summary: Native GTK4/Libadwaita web browser with AI assistance and local sync

description.p: Vingilot is a privacy-first, native Linux web browser designed for desktop and mobile. It features WebKitGTK 6.0 rendering, Círdan local encrypted password manager, Private incognito browsing, and offline portable sync bundles.

Version 0.1.4 release featuring GTK4 theme parser syntax fixes, translucent glassmorphic menu popovers with backdrop blur, redesigned 4-mode top selector circles (Auto Split, Light, Dark Neutral, True Black OLED), clean CLI parameter validation, and package updates.

Version 0.1.3 featuring persistent CSS theme providers, Nord Frost and dark appearance persistence, multi-engine prefix shortcuts (/e for Ecosia), interactive Find in Page popover, global keyboard accelerators, incognito sidebar toggle, and live preferences integration.

Beta release featuring native Libadwaita Start Page with dynamic search bar, customizable GNOME accent palette, recent cards with page previews, Opera-style drag-and-drop bookmark management, resizable settings pane, address bar bookmarking star, and distraction-free reading mode.

Alpha release featuring native Libadwaita Start Page with dynamic search bar, recently viewed cards with page previews, Opera-style drag-and-drop bookmark management, collapsible vertical tab sidebar, and unified chrome styling.
